remarks.zh: 计算橱柜的板材尺寸。[宽度]、[高度]、[深度]是总尺寸，[板厚]是顶部、底部和侧板材料厚度，[背板厚度]是背板材料厚度。(AI translated, please check)
remarks.en: Calculates board sizes for a cabinet. [Width], [Height],[Depth] is total Measurement, [BoardThick] is Top, Bottom and Side Board material thickness, [BackBoardThick] is Back Board material thickness.
remarks.ms: Mengira saiz papan untuk kabinet. [Width], [Height],[Depth] adalah Ukuran keseluruhan, [BoardThick] ialah ketebalan bahan papan Atas, Bawah dan Sisi, [BackBoardThick] ialah ketebalan bahan papan Latar. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.id: Menghitung ukuran papan untuk lemari. [Width], [Height],[Depth] adalah Ukuran total, [BoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan Atas, Bawah, dan Samping, [BackBoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan Belakang. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.th: คำนวณขนาดแผ่นสำหรับตู้ [กว้าง], [สูง],[ลึก] คือขนาดทั้งหมด [หนาแผ่น] คือความหนาของวัสดุแผ่นด้านบน ด้านล่าง และด้านข้าง [หนาหลังแผ่น] คือความหนาของวัสดุแผ่นหลัง (AI translated, please check)
remarks.vi: Tính toán kích thước ván cho tủ. [Width], [Height],[Depth] là Tổng kích thước, [BoardThick] là Độ dày vật liệu ván trên, dưới và bên, [BackBoardThick] là Độ dày vật liệu ván nền. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.tl: Kinakalkula ang mga sukat ng tabla para sa isang kabinet. [Lapad], [Taas],[Lalim] ay Kabuuang Sukat, [Kapal ng Piraso] ay kapal ng materyal para sa Pang-itaas, Ibaba, at Tagiliran, [Kapal ng Likurang Piraso] ay kapal ng materyal para sa Likod. (AI translated, please check)
